newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ACCC allows Westpac's BML bid-paper.
newsitem.headline: ACCC allows Westpac's BML bid-paper.

text.p: Australia's anti-monopolies authority, the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC), has approved Westpac Banking Corp's A$1.44 billion bid for Bank of Melbourne, the Australian Financial Review said.
The newspaper said the approval was likely to be announced on Friday or early next week, after which it would have to be approved by the Treasurer and the Reserve Bank of Australia.

"The ACCC will stipulate that Westpac must give deposit-taking institutions access to its electronic banking network in Victoria at reasonable prices in order to enhance compeition in the Victorian market," the paper said.
